Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

description: `game.duel_odds` (state schema 18): how a duel between `demigod` and `target` would likely go (DM_RULEBOOK 21.2), from seeded trials: the same state gives the same odds.

idle_win_pct.description: 0..100: its chance if its player types nothing (the AI's counters still land).

my_dc.description: The DC the demigod's blows roll against.

my_health.description: Exact where the asker sees it (its own demigod, an open duel's hp), else a band: hale (7+), hurt, near death (3 or less).

my_mod.description: The demigod's blow modifier (wit +1, health, wardrobe, items, gear, home turf).

reach_ok.description: Both stand and the target is within the challenge's reach at `level`.

their_dc.description: The DC the target's blows roll against.

their_health.description: As my_health: a rival's exact health only inside an open duel.

their_mod.description: The target's (its private kit not counted).

too_far_km.description: How far beyond the reach the target stands.

win_pct.description: 0..100: the demigod's chance to win, typing a line every exchange (wit assumed +1).

title: game.duel_odds

x-args.description: Over HTTP every arg is a query-string parameter (numbers as numeric strings). Unknown args are ignored.

level.description: The board level the challenge would be issued at (regions, villages, houses, people; default regions): sets the reach.

x-description: State schema 18: how a duel between `demigod` and `target` would likely go, from the duel rules (DM_RULEBOOK 21.2): `win_pct` (you type a line every exchange), `idle_win_pct` (you type nothing), each side's health (exact where the asker sees it: its own demigods, an open duel's hp; else a band hale|hurt|near death, and the odds use the band), modifiers and DCs, `reach_ok` (+ `too_far_km`) and short `why` reasons. Seeded trials: the same state gives the same odds. Read-only, cheap.
